quiz.title: Lab9 Validation Checkpoint
quiz.instructions: Usability test quiz. Answer all four questions; answers save automatically. You have 3 attempts.

questions.text: Which heuristic says the interface should keep users informed about what is going on?
Which of these are states a student should be able to distinguish on a quiz screen?
If 350 students each save once every 5 seconds, what is the approximate save rate in requests per second?
Name the design heuristic that motivates keeping a question and its answer on the same surface.
